consequence.statement: Signing with 3072-bit or 4096-bit RSA keys now uses SHA-384 or SHA-512 rather than SHA-256; upstream expects minimal impact but advises users of larger RSA keys to be aware.

assertion.statement: From v1.17.0 cert-manager picks the RSA signature hash by key length (3072-bit uses SHA-384, 4096-bit uses SHA-512) instead of always using SHA-256.
